content: Align your architecture backlog with Tech Roadmap Prioritization (TRP) by John Walker , Akshaye Nanglia , and Ramesh Chidirala on 03 JUN 2026 in Architecture , Best Practices Permalink Share In this post, we show you how to run a one-hour prioritization session with your stakeholders, plot competing initiatives on a shared matrix by cost and impact and turn the result into an actionable architecture backlog – using a framework called Tech Roadmap Prioritization (TRP).
